name: Centipede
desc:
One night, one of your friends during a sleepover is bit by a mutant centipede. An arm grows from his hip. Then another from his neck. Then another from his ribs. Now he is hungry, and doesn't know right from wrong. Will you survive?

This game is inspired off of Piggy, Spider,  yadayadayada.

Most likely not adding a new chapter for RoyStanford's sake unless im bored or you guys bully me into submission. :)
